trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer for Connection Pooling
trello.desc: Raj needs to address the connection contention issue causing delays on the dashboard for accounts with many projects. Steps to complete this task: 1. Set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern. 2. Benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against the current setup. 3. Compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer. 4. Present the findings in the next product sync meeting.

trello.name: Fix Typo in Onboarding Email
trello.desc: Tom is tasked with correcting a typo in the onboarding email subject line. Steps to complete: 1. Locate the email template in the repository. 2. Correct the misspelling of "receive" in the subject line. 3. Submit the updated email for re-approval. 4. Ensure the fix is pushed through the email template repository today.

trello.name: Update Roadmap Document
trello.desc: Tom needs to correct the roadmap document which incorrectly lists dark mode as a Q3 commitment. Steps to complete: 1. Access the roadmap document. 2. Move the dark mode item under the September design-system upgrade section. 3. Ensure sales and other stakeholders are aware of this update to prevent miscommunication about dark mode availability.
